search_question: How can business automation give me more time outside work?
direct_answer: Business automation can give an owner more time outside work by removing repeated admin, copying, chasing and routine handoffs from their day. Start with one workflow that happens often, has clear rules and creates little value when the owner performs it manually.
promotion_hypothesis: A real Sydney leisure setting makes the benefit of practical automation immediate and gives the audience a personally meaningful question to answer.
